name: PJSA110_Hakuryu
description: The G-15 project, or the Improved Taihō, had larger dimensions, an enhanced armor layout, and an increased air group compared to her predecessor. It was planned to build a series of seven ships, and the construction process was scheduled to end in 1948. After the Battle of Midway, these plans were suspended in favor of the Unryū-type aircraft carriers with a simpler design, and they were eventually entirely abandoned in 1943.

consumables.name: Damage Control Party
consumables.description:
Extinguishes fires, removes instances of flooding, and repairs damaged modules.
Prevents enemy submarine-launched torpedoes from homing.

consumables.name: Interceptors
consumables.description:
Follow the ship and automatically attack enemy aircraft.

Can attack Airstrike squadrons multiple times before returning to the ship.

Invulnerable against hostile fighters, do not attack them, and cannot spot enemy ships.
